full_prompt_en: A square Baroque oil portrait shows an older gray-haired man seated at a desk with a pen and open papers. The background is a deep warm brown that becomes nearly black at the left edge, making the illuminated figure emerge from darkness. His large curled gray hair frames his face and shoulders, and a pale mustache crosses a faintly smiling mouth. He turns slightly toward the left but meets the viewer with a direct, calm gaze. Fine wrinkles around the eyes and forehead are modeled in warm flesh tones rather than drawn as hard lines. An ivory neckcloth gathers beneath the chin, partly hidden by a heavy copper-brown robe. The robe has broad folds and glossy highlights along its right sleeve, which occupies much of the lower right. His left forearm rests across the desk, while the right hand holds a thin pen above a large open sheet. Cream paper extends across the lower left and center, its loose pages catching light along the edges. Small writing marks on the sheet are too faint to read. A dark rounded object sits near the far left edge of the desk, partly lost in shadow. The desk itself is a muted brown slab, visible along the lower edge and beneath the forearms. Warm directional light enters from the upper left, touching the forehead, nose, hands, neckcloth, paper, and raised folds of fabric. It fades rapidly into deep brown behind the shoulders and beneath the desk, creating a compact pool of illumination. The brushwork smooths facial transitions but leaves broad, tactile passages in the robe and rougher darks in the background. The overall composition is intimate and dignified, placing a sharply lit face and writing hand within rich copper and umber shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形巴洛克油画肖像呈现一名灰发年长男子，坐在书桌旁，面前有笔和摊开的纸张。背景是深暖棕色，到左边缘变得近乎黑色，让受光人物从暗处浮现。他浓密卷曲的灰发围住脸和肩膀，浅色胡须横过略带笑意的嘴。身体略向左转，目光却平静地直视观者。眼角和额头细纹由温暖肤色塑形，而非用硬线画出。一条象牙色颈巾聚在下巴下方，部分藏在厚重的铜棕色袍服里。袍服有宽大褶皱，右袖沿线闪出亮光，占据右下大半区域。左前臂横放在桌上，右手则把细笔悬在一大张摊开的纸上。奶油色纸张铺过左下和中央，松散的页边接住光。纸上隐约的笔迹细到无法辨读。书桌最左缘有一个深色圆物，部分消失在阴影中。桌面本身是一块暗棕色平板，在下缘及前臂下面可见。暖色定向光从左上方进入，落在额头、鼻子、手、颈巾、纸张和衣料隆起的褶面。光在肩膀后方及桌下迅速衰减为深棕，形成紧凑的受光区域。笔触使脸部转调平顺，却在袍服保留宽大可感的色层，在背景深处留下更粗糙的暗色。整体构图亲密而庄重，把清楚受光的面容与写字的手安放在浓郁铜色及赭棕阴影之中。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting concentrates warm directional light within an enveloping field of deep umber and near-black. Smooth, carefully modeled focal passages contrast with broad tactile strokes across heavier surfaces. Copper, sienna, ivory, and muted flesh tones form a narrow but rich palette, with pale accents reserved for the brightest edges. Light slips across raised folds and rounded planes, then falls quickly into shadow so depth comes from chiaroscuro rather than strong outlines. The composition gathers its clearest details into a compact central zone and allows the outer areas to dissolve into darkness. Horizontal supporting planes anchor fuller curved masses. The overall effect is intimate, dignified, and quietly theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅油画把暖色定向光集中在深赭棕和近黑色包围的场域里。平顺且细致塑形的焦点区域，与厚重表面上宽阔可感的笔触形成对照。铜色、赭红、象牙色和暗肤色组成狭窄却丰厚的色域，浅色重音只留给最亮边缘。光掠过隆起褶面和圆润平面，随后快速落入阴影，使纵深来自明暗对照，而非粗重描线。构图把最清楚的细节聚在紧凑的中央区域，外缘逐渐消融进黑暗。水平的承托平面稳住更饱满的弯曲体块。整体效果亲密、庄重而安静地富有戏剧性。
theme_en: A gray-haired scholar with pen and papers in warm candlelike light
theme_zh: 暖烛光中持笔与纸张的灰发学者
name: Nicolas Mignard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
